newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's SKB says to buy 51 pct of UBK.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's SKB says to buy 51 pct of UBK.

text.p: Slovenia's second-largest bank SKB said on Thursday it would buy 51 percent of bank UBK, assuming majority ownership of the smaller bank on July 1.
"Our link-up will have a positive effect for both banks. It will reduce costs especially concerning investment in development," Ivan Nerad, chief executive of SKB told a news conference.
The two banks will form a new banking group around SKB, which plans to raise its share of the Slovenian market to 16 percent by the year 2000 from the current 11.2 percent.
UBK has a share of less than one percent and is among the smallest of the tiny Alpine republic's 28 banks. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom +386 61 125 8439
